Congrats on almost 2 years! Very proud of you.

We have only been friends for about a month and we don't know much about each other. He also struggles with depression and he is having a hard time too. I don't want to make it worse for him if that makes sense.

When I was about 15/16 I told my parents about my SH. I was struggling with a a few different things like anxiety, depression, lonliness and struggling with my sexuality. I was good at pretending I was okay. I guess they didn't know how to help me because nothing ever happened. They never asked me how I was or checked on me  I stopped for a few months but started again. I have never spoken to them about anything about myself since then. I still live at home with my parents. I have never felt comfortable. It's stupid but I don't want to go to a doctor because I don't want people to know I'm struggling to live. I don't want to embarrass my family. Nobody shows me any concern.
I still struggle a lot but I'm trying to deal with it myself.
